subject.title: CSIT-602 - Machine Learning
commonInstructions: In case of any doubt or dispute the English version question should be treated as final.

subQuestions.label: a)
subQuestions.text: Define machine learning and explain its importance in solving real-world problems.

subQuestions.label: b)
subQuestions.text: Discuss the role of probability in machine learning. How is Bayes' theorem used in classification tasks, and why is it fundamental in probabilistic models?

subQuestions.label: a)
subQuestions.text: Compare $L_1$ and $L_2$ regularization in machine learning. How do these techniques prevent overfitting, and what is the difference in the impact they have on model weights?

subQuestions.label: b)
subQuestions.text: What are Autoencoders, and how are they used in unsupervised learning?

subQuestions.label: a)
subQuestions.text: Explain the architecture of a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN).

subQuestions.label: b)
subQuestions.text: Define one-shot learning and explain how it differs from traditional supervised learning. Discuss applications where one-shot learning is particularly beneficial.

subQuestions.label: a)
subQuestions.text: What are some popular frameworks for implementing reinforcement learning, such as OpenAI Gym or TensorFlow Agents?

subQuestions.label: b)
subQuestions.text: What is Q-learning, and how does it use the Q-value to guide an agent's action?

subQuestions.label: a)
subQuestions.text: How is machine learning applied in speech processing such as speech-to-text and speaker identification?

subQuestions.text: Discuss the importance of loss calculation in guiding the backpropagation and optimization process.

subQuestions.text: Discuss the role of LSTMs in natural language generation models like ChatGPT and how they handle long-term dependencies.
